title: Man pleads guilty to beating his girlfriend to death in Worcester in 2021
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Crime Kyle Curley, 35, was living with Erica Lara in 2021.
A man was sentenced to life in prison for the 2021 murder of his girlfriend in Worcester, prosecutors announced Tuesday.
Kyle Curley, 35, pleaded guilty to second-degree murder and was sentenced to life with the possibility of parole after 21 years on Monday, according to the Worcester District Attorney’s Office.
